mira.platform: Quick repro: SDK auth header disappears after bundling edge function with Vite. Putting notes here.

mira.platform: Steps:
1) edge handler imports @redwood/inference-sdk (ESM)
2) build with Vite SSR (target=esnext, default esbuild)
3) Deployed bundle: outgoing fetch from SDK lacks Authorization header -> 401s and retries

sam.sdk: did you check unbundled dev server?

mira.platform: yes, dev server has header. Problem appears after bundling. Compiled bundle shows require() + sdk.default access.

mira.platform: bundle snippet:
```js
const sdk = require('@redwood/inference-sdk');
const headers = Object.assign({}, sdk.default?.auth?.getHeaders?.() || {});
fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers });
```

ivy.docs: sounds like ESM/CJS interop wrapper. Vite/esbuild sometimes injects default wrappers.

sam.sdk: short-term fix in SDK runtime: resolve imported module defensively (check __esModule and .default). Also add package.json exports to pick ESM/CJS entries so bundlers don't guess.

mira.platform: local workaround: set `build.commonjsOptions.transformMixedEsModules = true` and `VITE_SSR_NO_EXTERNAL=true` in vite.config to avoid the wrapper.

build-bot: build:edge-sample #2189999999 queued (vite/rollup/webpack matrix).

sam.sdk: I'll open a small patch: runtime import guard + exports map + tests across bundlers. We'll also add a short onboarding note about Vite SSR flags in the samples.

ivy.docs: please add the Vite note to onboarding docs once PR lands.

mira.platform: attaching a tiny repro repo in the ticket. Thanks!
